name: Bodyguard for Hire
objectiveText: Escort the Gizelton Caravan past the Kolkar Centaur village. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.   Escort Gizelton Caravan past Kolkar Centaur Village  ( 1 )

comments.body:
This is one of a pair of caravan escort quests, the other being [quest=5943].  The caravan in question patrols back and forth between Kormek's Hut and the junction just north of Gelkis Village in the south, following the eastern road past Kolkar Village, then along the road that passes through Mannoroc Coven.

This quest is done on the southward journey.

Rough timeline is as follows:

[ul]
[li]00:00: Caravan arrives from it's previous northward journey.  [npc=12245] spawns.[/li]
[li]10:00: [npc=11625] says: "[i]So sorry to leave a customer but we have places to go and people to swindle. We will be back sometime later today. Good-bye![/i]".  Vendor-Tron 1000 despawns.  Caravan sets off eastwards.[/li]
[li]11:32: Caravan halts on eastern road.  Cork Gizelton yells zonewide "[i]I am looking for some bodyguards that would like to protect the Gizelton Caravan. We are stopped on the road east of Kormek's Hut, north of Kolkar Centaur Village.[/i]"  This quest then becomes available from him.[/li]
[/ul]

Once the quest is accepted, the caravan proceeds at a walking pace southwards along the road.

There are three ambushes by Kolkar centaur, each ambush consisting of two [npc=12976] and two [npc=12977].

After the third ambush, the caravan continues a little further then halts briefly, where the quest objective is completed.  The caravan then continues on at normal pace to the far end of its route.

[ul]
[li]~23:00: Caravan arrives at destination (time dependant on ambush delays).[/li]
[/ul]

You don't need to stay with the caravan after the quest objective is completed and can go hand in the quest at Scrabblescrew's Camp (where the Kodo Collection quest is done).

Just a heads up. If you are using Questie add-on as I am with the newer Classic WoW. The location on the Map shown is INCORRECT. The location to wait for this Quest to begin is at 61.0 38.0 (<----If you also use Tom-Tom type in these cords) The Vendor Tron 1000 will spawn EVERY hour on the hour at approx 00:36 minutes after and will begin the quest shortly after. (If you have Cooking I recommend purchasing every recipe that he sells.) Not too worry when the Caravan begins to move up the road. You will have the chance to pick up the Escort quest when they stop a little bit up the road @ 67.0 37.0 (00:42 past each hour). (Just a heads up I was lucky to get the Gun drop Ironweaver ([item=13137 domain=classic]) on one of the spawns that the Caravan stopped to fight. I solo's this Escort Quest as a 38 BM Hunter with NO issues. The entire Caravan (even the Kodos) fight with you during the journey.
